body: Operator report: during a brief upstream hiccup every client retried at once in a tight loop and turned it into a full outage. app/retryer.py call_with_retry(fn, max_attempts=3, sleep=...) is documented to sleep backoff_delay(n) before retry number n (backoff_delay is correct: 0.1, 0.2, 0.4 for attempts 0, 1, 2), but the loop never sleeps at all — it retries immediately. Fix call_with_retry() so that before each retry it calls sleep(backoff_delay(attempt)) with attempt counting from 0 for the first retry, the final attempt's exception still propagates unchanged, and a first-try success never sleeps. Acceptance: a function failing twice then succeeding returns its result with recorded sleep delays [0.1, 0.2]; a function that always fails raises its own exception after 3 attempts with recorded delays [0.1, 0.2]; existing tests still pass.
title: Retry loop storms the upstream with no backoff
